mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits users in team A to be sharees on tasks in team B, violating the fundamental cross-team isolation guarantee. The injection creates a cross-team sharee entry, which all three isolation assertions must reject. Tests whether cross-team barrier is enforced only here.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamSharing { some u: User, t: Task | u.team != t.team and u in t.shared_with }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to record share operations performed by non-owners. The injection creates a scenario where a sharee was added by someone other than the task owner, violating the ownership-based access control invariant. Tests that only the owner can modify the shared_with list.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerShare { some t: Task, u: User, ae: AuditEntry | u in t.shared_with and ae.task = t and ae.operation = Shared and ae.actor != t.owner }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows tasks to exist without a corresponding creation audit entry, violating the audit completeness guarantee. The injection creates a task with no Created entry in the audit log, which the assertion must catch. Tests that all tasks produce a creation entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCreationAudit { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.operation = Created }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to be attributed to actors in different teams than the task itself, violating the invariant that only in-team actors can modify in-team tasks. The injection creates a cross-team attribution, which the assertion must reject. Tests that audit log actors are always legitimate members of the task's team.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.actor.team != ae.task.team }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows users to be added to shared_with without generating a corresponding Shared audit entry, breaking the one-to-one mapping between state changes and audit events. The injection creates a sharee with no Shared entry in the audit trail, violating completeness. Tests that share operations are always logged.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoShareAudit { some t: Task, u: User | u in t.shared_with and no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.operation = Shared }
